The '''crystalline dragon''' is a mini-boss monster found in the [[Gauntlet]] that attacks with [[Magic]]. Its counterpart in the [[The Gauntlet#Corrupted Gauntlet|Corrupted Gauntlet]] is the [[corrupted dragon]]. Mini-boss monsters always spawn alone, and only appear at the edges of the Gauntlet map.
